subject: expression: Support cast decimal as real push down to tiflash (#50977)
summary: Reviewed commit diff vs first parent (f46bdedc2b6b3564bed9c110099b10418198765e). Change only expands TiFlash pushdown allowlist to include `tipb.ScalarFuncSig_CastDecimalAsReal` in `pkg/expression/infer_pushdown.go`, plus adds a corresponding pushdown test case for `CAST(decimal AS DOUBLE)` in `pkg/expression/expr_to_pb_test.go`. No correctness/semantics/compatibility Blocker/High issues found from the TiDB-side pushdown gating logic. Checked later history up to `upstream/master`; this support remains present (not reverted/adjusted).
